# armonia

Tools for harmonizing multilingual and multi-wave research datasets.
`armonia` generates an Excel-based data dictionary that maps raw
variable names and categorical values to a standardized schema, applies
that mapping to rename variables and recode factors, safely row-binds
and column-binds waves, and anonymizes participant identifiers via
salted SHA-256 hashing.

Real-world longitudinal studies collect data across multiple waves,
often with different teams, questionnaire versions, or even languages.
The result is a collection of data frames that should be equivalent but
often aren’t: column names differ, factor labels are in different
languages, or values accumulate small typos over time. `armonia` handles
this in four phases: build a dictionary, standardize each wave against
it, assemble the waves into one dataset, and anonymize participant
identifiers.

## Installation

`armonia` is not yet on CRAN. Until it is, install from a local clone:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_local("path/to/armonia")
```

## Quick example

[`dict_init()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/dict_init.md)
scans your waves and writes an Excel dictionary skeleton for you to
review;
[`dict_apply()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/dict_apply.md)
then applies a reviewed dictionary to standardize a wave:

``` r

library(armonia)

wave1 <- data.frame(id = c("alice", "bob"), gender = c("Female", "Male"))

dict_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")
openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  list(
    Variable_Map_Wide = data.frame(target_name = c("id", "gender"), orig_w1 = c("id", "gender")),
    Factor_Levels = data.frame(
      wave = "orig_w1", original_variable = "gender", target_name = "gender",
      original_level = c("Female", "Male"), standard_code = c(1, 2), standard_label = c("Female", "Male")
    )
  ),
  file = dict_path
)

dict_apply(wave1, dict_path, source_name = "orig_w1")
```

## Learn more

The package vignette walks through the full four-phase workflow on a
fictional longitudinal study:

``` r

vignette("armonia")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`anon_clean_email()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/anon_clean_email.md)
  : Clean and standardize email strings
- [`anon_hash()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/anon_hash.md)
  : Generate pseudonymous research IDs via salted hashing
- [`assign_standard_labels()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/assign_standard_labels.md)
  : Assign standard labels to factor variables using the dictionary
- [`check_bind_ready()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/check_bind_ready.md)
  : Check class consistency across waves before binding
- [`check_data_loss()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/check_data_loss.md)
  : Check for data loss after transformation and binding
- [`check_email()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/check_email.md)
  : Flag structurally suspicious email addresses
- [`check_id_audit()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/check_id_audit.md)
  : Audit primary key matching between two ID columns
- [`check_integrity()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/check_integrity.md)
  : Final integrity check for harmonized data
- [`detect_multival()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/detect_multival.md)
  : Detect columns containing multi-value cells
- [`dict_apply()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/dict_apply.md)
  : Apply dictionary mapping and standardize categorical values
- [`dict_check_compat()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/dict_check_compat.md)
  : Check whether an armonia dictionary is applicable to a new dataset
- [`dict_init()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/dict_init.md)
  : Initialize a data dictionary
- [`dict_merge()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/dict_merge.md)
  : Merge two data dictionary workbooks
- [`dict_validate()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/dict_validate.md)
  : Validate an armonia dictionary file
- [`flag_duplicate_cases()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/flag_duplicate_cases.md)
  : Flag potentially duplicate cases across waves
- [`harm_add_timepoint()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/harm_add_timepoint.md)
  : Append a New Longitudinal Timepoint
- [`harm_bind_waves()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/harm_bind_waves.md)
  : Bind harmonized waves into a master dataset
- [`normalize_id()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/normalize_id.md)
  : Normalize identifier strings
- [`split_multival()`](https://icg-cat.github.io/armonia/reference/split_multival.md)
  : Convert a multi-value column into dummy indicator columns
